Enriching ArCo: Saint Charalampius

Marina Khamokova

Introduction

Russian iconography is a rich and significant field of cultural and religious heritage. Among the Russian icons preserved in Italian museums, I chose an eighteenth-century icon of Saint Charalampius held at the Museo Diocesano di Brescia. It depicts the saint surrounded by scenes from his life and martyrdom.

Explore the project

Abstract

This project explores how Large Language Models can help enrich ArCo, the Italian cultural heritage knowledge graph. It focuses on an eighteenth-century Russian icon of Saint Charalampius held in Brescia. SPARQL queries were used to identify gaps in historical information and iconographic description. ChatGPT and Perplexity were tested with three prompting techniques. Their answers and sources informed two proposed RDF triples, which require source verification.
